description: Create a new Goal in a Workspace with optional due date, description, owners and color. Returns the created Goal with its id. Add measurable targets afterwards with `create_key_result`.

color.description: Accent color for the Goal as a hex string, e.g. #2ecd6f.

description.description: Optional description of what the Goal aims to achieve.

due_date.description: Target/due date. Accepts natural language ('next friday'), ISO date, or epoch milliseconds.

multiple_owners.description: If true, allow more than one owner on the Goal.

owners.description: User ids to set as the Goal's owners.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: create_goal
